'''Peller''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Ossus]], Peller led two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[PT-7 starfighter]]s, [[Red group (Republic Starfighter Corps)|red group]] and [[blue group]] to defend the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />
